mechanism: The generic retry uses the ordinary refresh path, which asks for confirmation before discarding unsaved edit values.
trigger: A list read has failed and an edit form contains unsaved values when the user clicks Try again.
expectedBehavior: A declined confirmation leaves the form and its unsaved values intact; an accepted confirmation permits refresh.
incorrectBehavior: N/A; the generic retry honors the existing discard confirmation.
reproduction: With confirmDiscard returning false, call retryListRefresh; it returns false without calling loadLatest. With confirmation accepted, it loads the latest list.
unacceptableAllegations: Claiming the retry prevents all possible overlapping operations or introduces unrelated behavior.
